name: OL Kankin Zecchou Choukyou
source:
The protagonist, "Kouhei Yamaji," is a part-time worker.
One day, he goes to the bank to withdraw his wages and encounters an office lady, "Yui Ichihara."

Fascinated by her appearance, which suits his tastes, he develops wicked desires.
Then, he comes up with a plan to kidnap and imprison her...
translation: 主角“山路公平”是一名兼职员工。某天，他去银行领取工资时，遇见了职场女性“市原结”。她的外表正合他的喜好，令他心生邪念。于是，他策划绑架并囚禁她……
